headline: Etsy Is In Its Flop Era, and Sellers Are Fleeing
context: Once a quirky bastion of amateur vulva jewelry and pet portraits, Etsy is now deluged with mass-produced goods and AI knockoffs. Some customers don’t seem to mind.
